body.p: In response to the Notice of Incomplete Reply dated October 23, 2023, a substitute

specification has been provided (both marked and clean copies) which contains changes that are properly marked up with underlining for additions to the text and strikethrough for deletions. No new matter has been added.

Please charge any shortage in fees due in connection with the filing of this paper, including extension of time fees, to Deposit Account No. 50-0310 and please credit any excess fees to such deposit account.
